title: Dinner Lady Mango Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The flavour that put Dinner Lady on the eliquid map, Lemon Tart is just as astonishing today as when it first appeared. A pin-sharp evocation of a delicious lemon tart, this eliquid captures the rich, zesty tang of creamy lemon curd and crisp, buttery pastry to perfection. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit. Details: 10ml Nicotine Salt E-Liquid Available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength 50VG/50PG (50%/50%)
